name: Shounen Tanteidan Mahou Ningyou Edogawa Ranpo
original_name: 少年探偵団・魔法人形　江戸川乱歩
source:
A girl gidnapped by a strange puppeteer. 
A magical doll that moves at night.
A boy named Kobayashi of the Akechi Detective Agency embarks on a one-man investigation, but is unable to get close to the truth.
However, working together with the girls involved in the case, he gradually tracks down the culprits.
When the trick behind the two incidents is revealed, the case comes to a turbulent end. 
Original story by Edogawa Ranpo. (Studio ROUGHsketch)
translation:
一名少女遭到神秘的人偶师绑架。
一具魔法人偶在夜间自行活动。

明智侦探事务所的少年小林独自展开调查，却始终无法接近真相。不过，在与卷入案件的少女们携手合作后，他逐渐逼近了犯人。

当两起事件背后的诡计被揭穿时，案件也迎来了波澜起伏的结局。
原作：江户川乱步。（Studio ROUGHsketch）
